ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with a single high-intensity (white) localized region at the axial center.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Visible high-contrast white pigment patch restricted to the vertex of the median notch; remaining visible area is a uniform solid black band with high-frequency white specular highlights from water droplets.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; estimated interior pixel angle of approximately 45-55 degrees; notch vertex is clearly defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration across both lobes; right lobe posterior margin shows higher frequency of jagged peaks; amplitude of serrations varies from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slight concave curvature transitioning from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast cluster of textured, roughly circular white/grey nodules localized on the distal margin of the right fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of calcified epibionts (barnacles) attached to the posterior margin and dorsal-ventral transition of the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized white pigmentation at the notch vertex forming a distinct 'V' or 'chevron' shape against the otherwise black fluke.
